name: Eden no Tenshi to Ange no Kyuuketsuki
original_name: エデンの天使とアンジュの吸血鬼
source:
-The story of a healthy girl who summoned a vampire to revive her father and a poor vampire who was captured in the past.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28414]Freem![/url]]
translation:
- 一个健康的女孩召唤吸血鬼来复活她的父亲和一个过去被俘虏的可怜的吸血鬼的故事。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28414]Freem![/url]]
